 EX-99.1 | Exhibit 99.1 | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE | DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Results 
 – DICK'S Business Delivers 2.6% Comp Sales Growth (A) – 
 – Foot Locker Business Delivers 0.5% Comp Sales Growth (A) (B) – 
 ● Delivered earnings per diluted share of $1.87 and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share of $1.94 (C) compared to earnings per diluted share of $0.86 and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share of $2.07 in the prior year quarter 
 ● Opened six new House of Sport locations and three new DICK'S Field House locations during the third quarter, bringing the total footprint to 47 House of Sport and 55 DICK'S Field House locations nationwide 
 ● Repurchased 6.7 million shares of common stock for $903 million during the third quarter 
 ● GameChanger marks ten years as part of DICK’S, with full-year 2026 revenue expected to approach $200 million 
 ● Raises low end of full year 2026 comp sales outlook and raises operating income outlook for the DICK'S Business; Maintains full year 2026 comp sales and profitability expectations for the Foot Locker Business 
 ● Raises full year 2026 consolidated earnings per diluted share guidance to a range of $11.40 to 12.25, compared to $10.94 to 11.94 previously; Raises full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per diluted share guidance to a range of $11.45 to 12.30, compared to $11.00 to 12.00 previously | "Our third quarter performance was driven by another strong quarter in the DICK'S Business, which continues to benefit from the breadth and flexibility of our portfolio. We're gaining market share, and we're very confident in our competitive position. We also made progress at Foot Locker and delivered a slightly positive comp, despite a continued challenging athletic footwear marketplace. The US Foot Locker banner was a particular bright spot, with comps up over 4%. During the quarter, we returned over $900 million of capital to shareholders through the opportunistic repurchase of 6.7 million shares, showing our conviction in the long-term value of the company and the opportunities ahead." 
 Ed Stack, Executive Chairman 
 "We're proud of our company's Q3 results. We delivered another strong quarter in the DICK'S Business and saw encouraging progress at Foot Locker. Comp sales for the DICK'S Business increased 2.6%, including a very strong back-to-school season. Athletes are responding to newness and innovation, and our increasingly differentiated assortment gives them more reasons to choose DICK'S. We're continuing to invest behind our long-term growth opportunities. House of Sport has delivered strong sales, profitability and returns, while GameChanger continues to scale and deepen our relationship with millions of youth athletes and families. Given our continued confidence in the DICK'S Business, we are raising the low end of our full-year 2026 comp sales outlook and increasing our operating income expectations." 
 Lauren Hobart, President and Chief Executive Officer | PITTSBURGH, November 24, 2026 - DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS), a leading global sports retailer, today reported sales and earnings results for the third quarter ended October 31, 2026. 
 (A) Results described by management for the "DICK'S Business" represent the existing DICK'S Sporting Goods operations, which includes the DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Going Going Gone! and Public Lands banners in addition to our experiential retail concepts DICK'S House of Sport, DICK'S Field House, and Golf Galaxy Performance Center, as well as GameChanger. The results for the "Foot Locker Business" represent our Foot Locker, Inc. ("Foot Locker") acquired operations, including the Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners. Profitability for the DICK'S and Foot Locker Businesses represents segment profit, or operating income, for a respective segment. 
 (B) Comparable sales for the Foot Locker Business are represented on a proforma basis and are calculated as if Foot Locker had been acquired at the beginning of the periods presented. Foot Locker will not be included in quarterly comparable sales until the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 and full year comparable sales in fiscal 2027. 
 (C) For additional information, see the section of this release titled "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" and GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations included in tables later in this release under the heading "GAAP to Non-GAAP Reconciliations." | DICK'S SPORTING GOODS, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES
